data: Muškarac samo želi voziti taksi i brinuti se o svojoj slijepoj ženi, ali neočekivani događaji prijete njegovom bezbrižnom postojanju i on se uvlači u prljave živote svojih putnika. (A questionable competition is taking place between undertakers from two German communities who are vying for the upcoming funeral of a 114-year-old woman.)
Muškarac samo želi voziti taksi i brinuti se o svojoj slijepoj ženi, ali neočekivani događaji prijete njegovom bezbrižnom postojanju i on se uvlači u prljave živote svojih putnika.
A questionable competition is taking place between undertakers from two German communities who are vying for the upcoming funeral of a 114-year-old woman.
